A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''stormtrooper''' served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he served aboard [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], and took part in the ''Devastator''{{'s}} [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. During the [[Lightfight|engagement]], the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was the first to [[Death/Legends|die]] when he was shot by the opposing [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]]' [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CSWE" /> served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]<ref name="ANH" /> in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]],<ref name="BF2" /> an elite [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Legion/Legends|unit]] under the direct command of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] was stationed on the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']],<ref name="ANH" /> [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=''Devastator''}}</ref>

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" /> [[Spy/Legends|agents]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] managed to [[Battle of Toprawa|steal]] the [[Death Star plans/Legends|secret plans]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], and transferred them to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[Consular ship/Legends|consular ship]], the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. The ''Devastator'' pursued and [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|overtook]] the ''Tantive IV'' in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], and the stormtrooper was among the first wave of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] who entered the corridors of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] and [[Lightfight|engaged]] the [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] defending the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] in battle. [[Standard second|Seconds]] after entering the corridor, the stormtrooper was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire&mdash;the first casualty of the battle. The skirmish ended in a victory for the 501st Legion and with Organa's capture. However, the Rebel [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] managed to evacuate the ship in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], carrying the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] plans with them.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
The stormtrooper wore full [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], and wielded an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The stormtrooper first appeared in the [[December]] [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH novel" /> [[1977|One year later]], the trooper appeared in the film itself, portrayed by an uncredited extra,<ref name="ANH" /> whose scenes were filmed in mid-1976 in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]].<ref name="TMOSW">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> While in the film, he is depicted as being shot in the [[Armor/Legends|chestplate]],<ref name="ANH" /> the novel described him as shot in the helmet and having "pieces of armor, [[Bone/Legends|bone]], and flesh [sent] flying in all directions."<ref name="ANH novel" />

===''Trooper'' comic===
{{Quote|This Rebel vessel is a vital prize, Sergeant. Your men had better be up to the task.''"<br />"''Th&mdash;they are, my Lord&mdash;''You!'' You go in first.|The individual talking to Darth Vader, before ordering the protagonist of the ''Trooper'' comic to be the first to enter the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} corridor|<ref name="trooper">{{Tales|10|Trooper (comic story)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Trooper_1st_casualty.png|thumb|left|250px|The stormtrooper orders another stormtrooper to be the first to board the ''Tantive IV''.]]
On [[December 12]], [[2001]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53988/star_wars_tales_1999_10|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #10}}</ref> the [[Star Wars Tales 10|tenth issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]'s ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' series presented a story entitled "[[Trooper (comic story)|Trooper]]," which featured the [[Unidentified 501st stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] who was shot by Leia Organa later in the ''A New Hope'' film as its protagonist.<ref name="trooper" /> [[Leland Chee]], the Keeper of [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Holocron continuity database]], stated that elements of those ''Tales'' [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] are considered S-[[canon]] until referenced by C-canon materials.<ref name="canon">{{Blog|holocron|56|starwars.com forum HolocronKeeper comments archive}}</ref> However, he would later confirm on his Facebook page that this particular story was intended to be [[Infinities|non-canon]].<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=233318370022430&id=201820953172172|author=[[Leland Chee|Keeper of the Holocron]]|date=2011-07-11|quote=That Tales story was intended to be non-continuity.|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "Is the Trooper comic from Star Wars Tales 10 canon? [...]"}}</ref>

This stormtrooper made an appearance in the comic, in which he was given the [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]]. Following the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} capture by the ''Devastator'', he was in charge of the boarding party, and they were assembled in the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], where Darth Vader inspected them. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] told the Sergeant to take his mission seriously, to which the frightened stormtrooper assured the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] that he and his men were. Right before the Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]] entered the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} corridors to engage the Rebel troopers, the stormtrooper ordered the comic's protagonist to be the first one to enter, and, upon entering right behind the protagonist, was killed by a shot to the helmet,<ref name="trooper" /> as opposed to the chestplate as seen in the film.<ref name="ANH" />
